governance_state.fallback_recovery_rule: Two consecutive fresh independent BOUNDED_PASS reviews with zero Critical/High findings after remediation.

D1_exact_per_candidate_allowlist.rule: No path is discovered during integration. Only the 120 exact path+mode+type+blob entries in the independently reviewed allowlist may be materialized.
D1_exact_per_candidate_allowlist.full_branch_history_visibility: All 904 candidate changes relative to Slice7 are recorded in the full change inventory; unselected changes remain excluded.
D1_exact_per_candidate_allowlist.source_binding: Every allowlist entry binds exact roster candidate source_commit; any source mismatch or unlisted path hard-fails before materialization.
D1_exact_per_candidate_allowlist.tree_entry_identity: Verification is path + mode + type + blob, both at source tree and staged integrated index.

imported_slice_test_oracle.expected_per_slice: 16 tests for S8-S19 and S23-S46; 20 tests for repaired S20-S22 including successor tests
imported_slice_test_oracle.execution: each slice runs in an isolated subprocess using exact imported test file paths

inherited_baseline.hard_fail_on: any failure, skip, expected failure, unexpected success, or count mismatch

D2_integration_false_green.imported_identity_assertion: Before tests, every imported path must match exact allowlisted mode+blob in the integrated index.
D2_integration_false_green.monkeypatch_rule: No new integration-only monkeypatch/import-hook layer is permitted; imported tests run byte-exact as previously reviewed.

D3_integration_machinery_semantics.declarative_constraint: Materializer/oracle may perform Git identity checks, file materialization, subprocess test invocation, result counting, and metadata emission only.
prohibited: direct import/call of r8_v15_r1 production validators by integration machinery
D3_integration_machinery_semantics.machinery_binding: Activation workflow hard-fails unless current proposal blob and all integration machinery blobs equal the exact user-approved/reviewed bindings.

D4_rejected_predecessor_and_descendant_e.unreviewed_descendants: Impossible as source: materializer accepts only exact source commits recorded in reviewed allowlist.
D4_rejected_predecessor_and_descendant_e.rejected_predecessors: S20-S22 rejected predecessor commits are never materialization sources.
D4_rejected_predecessor_and_descendant_e.repair_lineage_note: The exact reviewed S20-S22 successor candidates legitimately descend from their rejected predecessors; a blanket ancestry ban would reject the repaired lineages themselves.
D4_rejected_predecessor_and_descendant_e.rule: These are the only selected entries permitted to be byte-identical to rejected predecessor tree entries, because the exact successor candidates were independently re-reviewed and closed. Any additional identical selected entry hard-fails.

pre_materialization_hard_fail_rules: any selected path absent from exact reviewed allowlist
source commit not exactly the allowlisted reviewed candidate
any duplicate selected path, even when bytes match
any collision with reserved integration-only path
any S20-S22 rejected-predecessor identical entry outside the three explicit reaccepted test entries
frozen schema tree differs from exact frozen schema candidate
reviewed runtime implementation performs detected governance-history file IO
integration machinery violates declarative AST constraints
partial_materialization_policy: All source/collision/schema/machinery checks complete before the first checkout. A later ephemeral-runner failure may leave a partial local worktree, but no commit or push occurs until all 120 entries verify and the strict oracle passes.
governance_history_boundary: Governance history remains repository evidence on the governance base; imported runtime implementation is prohibited from detected file IO against governance-r8 history. No governance-history file is selected as a reviewed implementation entry.

stage2_semantic_integration.rule: Stage 2 remains separately preregistered and review-gated. A fresh independent review of exact Stage 1 integrated bytes is mandatory first.
